d: As an Assistant Manager, you will own the performance of operations - spanning the bicycle and EV fleet and tMart operations. You will be expected to operate independently, drive compliance, and work closely with cross-functional teams to improve how the fleet runs.
q: 3-5 years of experience in operations, ideally in last-mile delivery, e-commerce, or mobility tech.
Proven experience managing on-ground teams and working across functions.
Analytical thinking with a data-driven approach to decision-making.
Clear, structured communication across teams and seniority levels.
Strong ownership mindset — accountable for outcomes, not just outputs.
On-ground presence — comfortable in the field and confident making independent calls.
Proven stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Beginner to intermediate proficiency with AI tools, including Claude.
r: Own the operational strategy and performance of the fleet - optimizing the fleet mix across bicycles and EVs, and setting the roadmap in collaboration with stakeholders.
Track and analyze fleet performance metrics, translating data into structured updates and clear recommendations for leadership.
Drive compliance at tMarts - visiting regularly, ensuring riders are showing up and following protocols, with consistent enforcement and a clear action plan for violators.
Identify and drive long-term solutions to recurring operational challenges.
Continuously refine and improve SOPs - leveraging automation and system enhancements to drive efficiency and reduce manual dependency.
Drive cross-functional collaboration with Performance, 3PL, and Rider Lifecycle teams to resolve systemic issues and align on priorities.
Build a high-performing team, foster a culture of ownership and accountability, with clear communication, and alignment across city-level operations.

q: 2+ years of experience in an operational role.
Ability to document processes and guidelines.
Ability to work with large data and highlight key insights.
Ability to solve major issues efficiently, understand which issues require escalation, and propose documents/changes to mitigate.
Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant field is required
r: Performance monitoring and improvement, review fulfillment performance daily, weekly, and monthly across replacement rate, Item Not Found (INF), Item Not Delivered (IND), order failure rate, and seamless orders. Identify trends and recurring issues, prioritize opportunities by customer and business impact, and drive corrective actions through to measurable improvement.

Item availability and order completeness, reduce Item Not Found (INF), Item Not Delivered (IND) by improving the accuracy and timeliness of vendor stock feeds and addressing gaps between ordered and delivered items and quantities, accounting for successful replacements. Identify recurring issues across products, stores, and chains, prioritize those with the greatest customer and business impact, and use available operational and technical tools to implement immediate mitigations and sustainable solutions.

Replacement optimization and GMV protection, improve successful replacements by assessing the end-to-end replacement journey, including the relevance of generated suggestions, customer response windows, configurations, and vendor execution. Identify and validate improvements that increase replacement acceptance, protect GMV, and meet customer needs.

Order failure reduction, analyze failure reasons across vendor, customer, and logistics ownership to identify root causes, trends, and recurring patterns. Drive actions within vendor operations and coordinate with the relevant teams on other causes, combining immediate recovery measures with long-term prevention.

Seamless orders and fulfillment quality, Increase seamless orders by investigating late, incomplete, incorrect, damaged, spilled, or otherwise unsatisfactory orders, including related refunds and compensation. Work with the responsible teams to address recurring causes and verify that corrective actions improve customer outcomes.

Incident resolution and technical improvements, act as the operational point of contact for vendor fulfillment issues. Assess impact, raise actionable incident tickets, coordinate immediate workarounds, and drive resolution with Product, Technology, and other relevant teams. Validate fixes and identify system or process improvements that prevent recurrence.
Follow all relevant policies, procedures, and processes for the daily work to be carried out in a controlled and consistent manner
Contribute to the identification of opportunities for continuous improvement of processes, practices, work processes, cost effectiveness, and productivity enhancement
Promote to other employees within the organization the implementation and adherence to policies, procedures, processes, and instructions
Follow daily operations relating to the job to ensure work continuity
Contribute to preparing timely and accurate reports that concern the line of work to meet the requirements, objectives, and standards
Ensure the satisfaction of both internal and external by addressing their needs in a courteous and timely manner
